reason: Public v4.3.0 superseded by v4.3.1 after confirmed Windows startup-integrity and node-visibility regressions.

release.body:
FreeNet Hub 4.3.0 Final

Windows installer fix:
- Fixes fresh-install failure: "Free Net Hub could not verify the upgrade process state."
- Fresh install no longer runs previous-install verification when no app directory exists.
- Existing-install upgrades keep lifecycle-safety verification.
- Hosted exact fresh-install validation PASS on PR CI #167 and post-merge CI #168.
- Local regression: 189/189 PASS; public/security/release verifiers PASS.
